::: {#exm-relation-digraph}
#### The directed graph of "beats"

@fig-beats is the directed graph (@def-relation-digraph) of the relation $B$ of @exm-beats.
Each element of $G$ appears once,
where an arrow diagram (@def-arrow-diagram) of $B$ would draw $G$ twice, once in each column.
Starting from any element and following the arrows leads around the triangle,
and back to the start after three arrows.

::: {#fig-beats}
